<!--
Computation for the whole study (6 variables x 32 weights matrices).
Included by Columbus_Spatial_Analysis.Rmd with include = FALSE: it writes every CSV, PNG, RDS and JSON
in output/ and builds dashboard_html/index.html, but prints nothing into the report.
-->

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(sf); library(spdep); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(jsonlite); library(knitr); library(scales)
})
SEED  <- 20261112L   # seed tetap
NSIM  <- 9999L       # jumlah permutasi
ALPHA <- 0.05
VARS  <- c("HOVAL", "INC", "CRIME", "OPEN", "PLUMB", "DISCBD")
REF   <- "queen_W"   # spesifikasi acuan

OUT <- "output"
for (d in file.path(OUT, c("csv", "png", "rds", "json"))) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_csv <- function(df, name) write.csv(df, file.path(OUT, "csv", paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
save_png <- function(p, name, w = 9, h = 5.5) ggsave(file.path(OUT, "png", paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150, bg = ARC$field)

# one palette for every figure (also used by the report and the dashboard): analysis/style.R
source("analysis/style.R")
theme_set(theme_archive(11))
kt <- function(df, digits = 4, ...) kable(df, digits = digits, format.args = list(big.mark = ""), ...)
cat("R", R.version.string, "| sf", as.character(packageVersion("sf")),
    "| spdep", as.character(packageVersion("spdep")), "| spData", as.character(packageVersion("spData")), "\n")
```

```{r data}
stopifnot(file.exists(geoda_shp))

data_source
```

```{r descriptives}
skew <- function(v) { z <- v - mean(v); mean(z^3) / mean(z^2)^1.5 }
kurt <- function(v) { z <- v - mean(v); mean(z^4) / mean(z^2)^2 - 3 }
iqr_out <- function(v) { q <- quantile(v, c(.25, .75)); h <- 1.5 * diff(q); which(v < q[1] - h | v > q[2] + h) }
desc <- lapply(VARS, function(v) {
  x <- col[[v]]; o <- iqr_out(x)
  tibble(Variabel = v, n = length(x), Mean = mean(x), SD = sd(x), Min = min(x),
         Q1 = quantile(x, .25), Median = median(x), Q3 = quantile(x, .75), Max = max(x),
         Skewness = skew(x), `Excess kurtosis` = kurt(x),
         `Shapiro–Wilk p` = shapiro.test(x)$p.value, `n outlier (1,5·IQR)` = length(o),
         `POLYID outlier` = if (length(o)) paste(col$POLYID[o], collapse = ", ") else "–")
}) |> bind_rows()
var_desc <- c(HOVAL = "Nilai rumah (US$1.000)", INC = "Pendapatan rumah tangga (US$1.000)",
              CRIME = "Pencurian rumah & kendaraan per 1.000 RT", OPEN = "Luas ruang terbuka",
              PLUMB = "% unit rumah tanpa plumbing", DISCBD = "Jarak ke CBD")
# legend unit per variable; OPEN and DISCBD have no unit in the source documentation (spData::columbus)
var_unit <- c(HOVAL = "US$1.000", INC = "US$1.000", CRIME = "per 1.000 RT", OPEN = "satuan tidak\ndicatat sumber",
              PLUMB = "% unit", DISCBD = "satuan tidak\ndicatat sumber")
kt(desc, 3)
save_csv(desc, "03_statistik_deskriptif")
```

```{r weights-build}
d1max <- max(unlist(nbdists(knn2nb(knearneigh(cc, 1)), cc)))
THRESH <- c(0.62, 0.75, 0.90, 1.10, 1.35, 1.65)
K <- c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8)
stopifnot(min(THRESH) >= d1max)

specs <- bind_rows(
  tibble(family = "Contiguity", key = c("queen", "rook"), variant = c("Queen", "Rook"), param = NA_real_),
  tibble(family = "KNN", key = paste0("knn", K), variant = paste0("k = ", K), param = K),
  tibble(family = "Distance band", key = sprintf("band%03d", round(THRESH * 100)),
         variant = sprintf("d ≤ %.2f", THRESH), param = THRESH),
  tibble(family = "Inverse distance", key = c("idw1", "idw2"), variant = c("1/d", "1/d²"), param = c(1, 2))
) |> tidyr::crossing(style = c("B", "W")) |>
  mutate(family = factor(family, c("Contiguity", "KNN", "Distance band", "Inverse distance")),
         id = paste0(key, "_", style),
         style_label = case_when(style == "W" ~ "Row-standardized",
                                 family == "Inverse distance" ~ "Mentah (tanpa standardisasi)",
                                 TRUE ~ "Biner"),
         label = paste0(variant, " · ", style)) |>
  arrange(family, param, variant, style) |> mutate(order = row_number())

build_lw <- function(family, param, variant, style, g) {
  xy <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(g)))
  glist <- NULL
  nb <- switch(as.character(family),
    "Contiguity"       = poly2nb(g, queen = variant == "Queen"),
    "KNN"              = knn2nb(knearneigh(xy, k = param)),
    "Distance band"    = dnearneigh(xy, 0, param),
    "Inverse distance" = { nb <- dnearneigh(xy, 0, max(dist(xy)) * 1.001)
                           glist <- lapply(nbdists(nb, xy), function(d) 1 / d^param); nb })
  nb2listw(nb, glist = glist, style = style, zero.policy = TRUE)
}
LW <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(specs)), function(i)
  with(specs[i, ], build_lw(family, param, variant, style, col))), specs$id)
cat("Jarak tetangga-terdekat maksimum =", round(d1max, 4), "sp →  ambang minimum valid\n")
```

```{r weights-validate}
gal <- read.gal("data/geoda_sal/columbus.gal", region.id = col$POLYID)
nb_q <- LW$queen_B$neighbours; attr(nb_q, "region.id") <- attr(gal, "region.id")

anselin <- col.gal.nb; attr(anselin, "region.id") <- attr(gal, "region.id")

pq <- paste(pairs_of(nb_q)[, 1], pairs_of(nb_q)[, 2]); pa <- paste(pairs_of(anselin)[, 1], pairs_of(anselin)[, 2])
```

```{r units-invariance}
scale_k <- unname(coef(fx)[2])
xy_geom <- cc; xy_attr <- cbind(col$X, col$Y)
IC <- function(x, lw) c(I = moran(x, lw, length(x), Szero(lw))$I, C = geary(x, lw, length(x), length(x) - 1, Szero(lw))$C)
mk_lw <- function(xy, fam, p, st) {
  if (fam == "KNN") return(nb2listw(knn2nb(knearneigh(xy, p)), style = st))
  if (fam == "band") return(nb2listw(dnearneigh(xy, 0, p), style = st, zero.policy = TRUE))
  nb <- dnearneigh(xy, 0, max(dist(xy)) * 1.001); nb2listw(nb, glist = lapply(nbdists(nb, xy), function(d) 1 / d^p), style = st)
}
inv <- bind_rows(lapply(list(c("band", 1.10, "B"), c("idw", 1, "B"), c("idw", 2, "W")), function(sp) {
  p <- as.numeric(sp[2])
  bind_rows(lapply(VARS, function(v) {
    a <- IC(col[[v]], mk_lw(xy_geom, sp[1], p, sp[3]))
    b <- IC(col[[v]], mk_lw(xy_geom * scale_k, sp[1], if (sp[1] == "band") p * scale_k else p, sp[3]))
    tibble(spec = paste(sp, collapse = " "), var = v, dI = abs(a[["I"]] - b[["I"]]), dC = abs(a[["C"]] - b[["C"]]))
  }))
}))
knn_pt <- bind_rows(lapply(c(2, 4, 6), function(k) {
  na <- knn2nb(knearneigh(xy_geom, k)); nbb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(xy_attr, k))
  same <- mean(mapply(function(u, w) length(intersect(u, w)) / length(u), na, nbb))
  bind_rows(lapply(VARS, function(v) tibble(k = k, var = v, `% tetangga sama` = 100 * same,
    `I (centroid geometri)` = IC(col[[v]], nb2listw(na))[["I"]], `I (titik X/Y Anselin)` = IC(col[[v]], nb2listw(nbb))[["I"]])))
}))
units_tab <- tibble(`Uji` = c("Maks |ΔI| setelah skala jarak dikali faktor X/Y", "Maks |ΔC| setelah skala jarak dikali faktor X/Y",
                              "KNN: % tetangga sama (centroid geometri vs titik X/Y), min–maks",
                              "KNN: maks |ΔI| akibat pilihan titik"),
                    Nilai = c(format(max(inv$dI), digits = 3), format(max(inv$dC), digits = 3),
                              paste(round(min(knn_pt$`% tetangga sama`), 1), "–", round(max(knn_pt$`% tetangga sama`), 1)),
                              format(max(abs(knn_pt[[4]] - knn_pt[[5]])), digits = 3)))
kt(units_tab); stopifnot(max(inv$dI) < 1e-10, max(inv$dC) < 1e-10)
save_csv(units_tab, "04d_uji_satuan_dan_centroid"); save_csv(knn_pt, "04e_knn_centroid_vs_titik_anselin")
```

```{r global-compute}
perm_summ <- function(obs, sim, orient) {
  hi <- (sum(sim >= obs) + 1) / (length(sim) + 1); lo <- (sum(sim <= obs) + 1) / (length(sim) + 1)
  m <- mean(sim); s <- sd(sim)
  list(perm_mean = m, perm_sd = s, z_perm = orient * (obs - m) / s,
       p_two = min(1, 2 * min(hi, lo)),
       p_pos = if (orient > 0) hi else lo)   # satu sisi: arah autokorelasi positif
}
global_one <- function(x, lw, seed) {
  set.seed(seed);     mc <- moran.mc(x, lw, nsim = NSIM, zero.policy = TRUE)
  set.seed(seed + 1); gc <- geary.mc(x, lw, nsim = NSIM, zero.policy = TRUE)
  mt <- moran.test(x, lw, randomisation = TRUE, zero.policy = TRUE)
  gt <- geary.test(x, lw, randomisation = TRUE, zero.policy = TRUE)
  ms <- perm_summ(mc$statistic, head(mc$res, -1), +1)
  gs <- perm_summ(gc$statistic, head(gc$res, -1), -1)
  bind_rows(
    c(index = "Moran's I", stat = unname(mc$statistic), expected = unname(mt$estimate[2]),
      var_rand = unname(mt$estimate[3]), ms),
    c(index = "Geary's C", stat = unname(gc$statistic), expected = unname(gt$estimate[2]),
      var_rand = unname(gt$estimate[3]), gs)) |>
    mutate(across(-index, as.numeric))
}
t0 <- Sys.time()
glob <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(specs)), function(s) bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(VARS), function(v)
  global_one(col[[VARS[v]]], LW[[specs$id[s]]], SEED + 1000L * s + 10L * v) |>
    mutate(spec_id = specs$id[s], var = VARS[v]))))) |>
  mutate(z_rand = ifelse(index == "Moran's I", (stat - expected), (expected - stat)) / sqrt(var_rand),
         signif = p_two < ALPHA,
         conclusion = case_when(!signif ~ "Tidak signifikan",
                                index == "Moran's I" & stat > expected ~ "Positif",
                                index == "Geary's C" & stat < expected ~ "Positif",
                                TRUE ~ "Negatif"),
         # ukuran efek berorientasi (deterministik, tanpa noise Monte Carlo): >0 = autokorelasi positif
         es = ifelse(index == "Moran's I", stat - expected, expected - stat),
         # galat Monte Carlo p dua sisi: p = 2q, SE(p) = 2*sqrt(q(1-q)/R)
         p_mc_se = 2 * sqrt((p_two / 2) * (1 - p_two / 2) / NSIM),
         p_mc_lo = pmax(0, p_two - 1.96 * p_mc_se), p_mc_hi = pmin(1, p_two + 1.96 * p_mc_se),
         borderline = p_mc_lo <= ALPHA & p_mc_hi >= ALPHA) |>
  left_join(select(specs, spec_id = id, family, variant, style, style_label, param, label, order), by = "spec_id") |>
  relocate(spec_id, family, variant, style, var, index)
cat("Waktu komputasi:", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), 2), "menit;",
    nrow(glob), "uji ×", NSIM, "permutasi\n")
save_csv(glob, "05_global_moran_geary_semua_spesifikasi")
```

```{r audit}
# A1. Moran's I dan Geary's C dengan aljabar matriks langsung (rumus Bagian 2.1), 32 W × 6 variabel
ind <- bind_rows(lapply(specs$id, function(id) { W <- listw2mat(LW[[id]]); S0 <- sum(W)
  bind_rows(lapply(VARS, function(v) { x <- col[[v]]; z <- x - mean(x); n <- length(x)
    tibble(spec_id = id, var = v, I_man = n / S0 * sum(W * outer(z, z)) / sum(z^2),
           C_man = (n - 1) / (2 * S0) * sum(W * outer(x, x, "-")^2) / sum(z^2)) })) }))
a1 <- glob |> select(spec_id, var, index, stat) |> pivot_wider(names_from = index, values_from = stat) |> left_join(ind, by = c("spec_id", "var"))
dI_man <- max(abs(a1$`Moran's I` - a1$I_man)); dC_man <- max(abs(a1$`Geary's C` - a1$C_man))

# A2. Uji permutasi ditulis ulang tanpa spdep (Queen·W, seed berbeda), dibandingkan dengan galat Monte Carlo
own_perm <- function(x, W, R, seed) {
  set.seed(seed); n <- length(x); S0 <- sum(W)
  st <- function(v) { z <- v - mean(v); c(I = n / S0 * sum(z * (W %*% z)) / sum(z^2),
                                         C = (n - 1) / (2 * S0) * sum(W * outer(v, v, "-")^2) / sum(z^2)) }
  obs <- st(x); sim <- t(replicate(R, st(sample(x))))
  pt <- function(o, s) min(1, 2 * min((sum(s >= o) + 1) / (R + 1), (sum(s <= o) + 1) / (R + 1)))
  c(p_I = pt(obs[["I"]], sim[, "I"]), p_C = pt(obs[["C"]], sim[, "C"]),
    z_I = (obs[["I"]] - mean(sim[, "I"])) / sd(sim[, "I"]), z_C = (mean(sim[, "C"]) - obs[["C"]]) / sd(sim[, "C"]))
}
Wq <- listw2mat(LW[[REF]])
a2 <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(VARS), function(v) { o <- own_perm(col[[VARS[v]]], Wq, NSIM, SEED + 5000L + v)
  r <- glob |> filter(spec_id == REF, var == VARS[v])
  tibble(var = VARS[v], index = c("Moran's I", "Geary's C"), p_spdep = r$p_two[match(c("Moran's I", "Geary's C"), r$index)],
         p_sendiri = o[c("p_I", "p_C")], z_spdep = r$z_perm[match(c("Moran's I", "Geary's C"), r$index)], z_sendiri = o[c("z_I", "z_C")],
         se_mc = r$p_mc_se[match(c("Moran's I", "Geary's C"), r$index)]) })) |>
  mutate(`|Δp| / (√2·SE_MC)` = abs(p_spdep - p_sendiri) / (sqrt(2) * pmax(se_mc, 2 / (NSIM + 1))), dz = abs(z_spdep - z_sendiri))
kt(a2, 4); save_csv(a2, "05c_audit_permutasi_independen")

# A3. Noise Monte Carlo pada z: untuk KNN, W = B/k sehingga I dan C identik; selisih z murni noise permutasi
knn_pair <- glob |> filter(family == "KNN") |> mutate(base = sub("_[BW]$", "", spec_id)) |>
  select(base, var, index, style, stat, z_perm) |> pivot_wider(names_from = style, values_from = c(stat, z_perm))
d_stat_knn <- max(abs(knn_pair$stat_B - knn_pair$stat_W))
NOISE_DZ <- qnorm(0.975) * sd(knn_pair$z_perm_W - knn_pair$z_perm_B)   # selisih z dua run yang < ini dianggap noise

# A4. z permutasi vs z randomisasi analitik
a4 <- glob |> group_by(index) |> summarise(r = cor(z_perm, z_rand), maks = max(abs(z_perm - z_rand)), .groups = "drop")

audit <- tibble(
  Pemeriksaan = c("Maks |I spdep − I rumus matriks| (192 kasus)", "Maks |C spdep − C rumus matriks| (192 kasus)",
                  "Permutasi independen vs spdep: maks |Δp| / (√2 × SE Monte Carlo)", "Permutasi independen vs spdep: maks |Δz|",
                  "KNN: maks |I_B − I_W| dan |C_B − C_W| (harus 0)", "Batas noise Monte Carlo untuk selisih z (1,96 × SD)",
                  "Korelasi z permutasi vs z analitik: Moran | Geary", "Maks |z permutasi − z analitik|: Moran | Geary",
                  "Kasus di batas α (IK 95% Monte Carlo p memuat 0,05)"),
  Nilai = c(format(dI_man, digits = 3), format(dC_man, digits = 3), format(max(a2$`|Δp| / (√2·SE_MC)`), digits = 3),
            format(max(a2$dz), digits = 3), format(d_stat_knn, digits = 3), format(NOISE_DZ, digits = 3),
            paste(format(a4$r[a4$index == "Moran's I"], digits = 4), "|", format(a4$r[a4$index == "Geary's C"], digits = 4)),
            paste(format(a4$maks[a4$index == "Moran's I"], digits = 3), "|", format(a4$maks[a4$index == "Geary's C"], digits = 3)),
            paste(sum(glob$borderline), "dari", nrow(glob))))
kt(audit); save_csv(audit, "05b_audit_metodologi")
stopifnot(dI_man < 1e-10, dC_man < 1e-10, d_stat_knn < 1e-10, max(a2$`|Δp| / (√2·SE_MC)`) < 4)
```

```{r outlier-jackknife}
JK_REFS <- c("queen_W", "knn4_W", "idw1_W")
zr <- function(x, lw) {
  mt <- moran.test(x, lw, randomisation = TRUE, zero.policy = TRUE)$estimate
  gt <- geary.test(x, lw, randomisation = TRUE, zero.policy = TRUE)$estimate
  c(I = mt[[1]], esI = mt[[1]] - mt[[2]], zI = (mt[[1]] - mt[[2]]) / sqrt(mt[[3]]),
    C = gt[[1]], esC = gt[[2]] - gt[[1]], zC = (gt[[2]] - gt[[1]]) / sqrt(gt[[3]]))
}
zcrit <- qnorm(1 - ALPHA / 2)
jk <- bind_rows(lapply(JK_REFS, function(id) {
  s <- specs[specs$id == id, ]
  full <- sapply(VARS, function(v) zr(col[[v]], LW[[id]]))
  bind_rows(lapply(1:49, function(i) {
    g <- col[-i, ]; lw <- build_lw(s$family, s$param, s$variant, s$style, g)
    bind_rows(lapply(VARS, function(v) { r <- zr(g[[v]], lw)
      tibble(ref = id, var = v, drop_polyid = col$POLYID[i], index = c("Moran's I", "Geary's C"),
             stat = r[c("I", "C")], es = r[c("esI", "esC")], z = r[c("zI", "zC")],
             es_full = full[c("esI", "esC"), v], z_full = full[c("zI", "zC"), v]) }))
  }))
})) |> mutate(des = es - es_full, dz = z - z_full, sig_full = abs(z_full) > zcrit, sig_drop = abs(z) > zcrit)
jk_summ <- jk |> group_by(ref, var, index) |>
  summarise(`z penuh` = first(z_full), `Maks |ΔES|` = max(abs(des)), `Maks |Δz|` = max(abs(dz)),
            `POLYID paling berpengaruh` = drop_polyid[which.max(abs(dz))],
            `Penghapusan yang mengubah signifikansi` = sum(sig_drop != sig_full), .groups = "drop")
kt(jk_summ, 3)
save_csv(jk, "13_jackknife_detail"); save_csv(jk_summ, "14_jackknife_ringkasan")
```

```{r outlier-jackknife-plot, fig.height = 6}
  geom_point(aes(shape = index), size = 1.4) + facet_wrap(~var, ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COL_IDX) + scale_shape_manual(values = SHP_IDX) +
```

```{r outlier-rank}
  a <- zr(col[[v]], LW[[id]]); b <- zr(rank(col[[v]]), LW[[id]])
  tibble(spec_id = id, var = v, index = c("Moran's I", "Geary's C"), es_raw = a[c("esI", "esC")], es_rank = b[c("esI", "esC")],
         z_raw = a[c("zI", "zC")], z_rank = b[c("zI", "zC")])
})))) |> mutate(des = es_rank - es_raw, dz = z_rank - z_raw)

  summarise(`Rata-rata |ΔES|` = mean(abs(des)), `Rata-rata |Δz|` = mean(abs(dz)),
            `W berubah signifikansi` = sum((abs(z_rank) > zcrit) != (abs(z_raw) > zcrit)),
            `W signifikan (nilai asli)` = sum(abs(z_raw) > zcrit), `W signifikan (peringkat)` = sum(abs(z_rank) > zcrit), .groups = "drop")
kt(rank_summ, 3)
save_csv(rank_cmp, "15_transformasi_peringkat_detail"); save_csv(rank_summ, "16_transformasi_peringkat_ringkasan")
```

```{r decomposition}
decomp <- bind_rows(lapply(c("PLUMB", "HOVAL", "OPEN"), function(v) bind_rows(lapply(c("queen_B", "knn4_B", "band090_B", "band165_B", "idw1_B"), function(id) {
  x <- col[[v]]; z <- x - mean(x); M <- listw2mat(LW[[id]]); out <- seq_along(x) %in% iqr_out(x)
  inv <- outer(out, out, "|")
  gnum <- M * outer(x, x, "-")^2; mnum <- M * outer(z, z)
  tibble(var = v, spec_id = id, `n outlier` = sum(out),
         `% pasangan berbobot yg melibatkan outlier` = 100 * sum(M[inv]) / sum(M),
         `% pembilang Geary dari pasangan outlier` = 100 * sum(gnum[inv]) / sum(gnum),
         `% |pembilang Moran| dari pasangan outlier` = 100 * sum(abs(mnum[inv])) / sum(abs(mnum)),
         `Pembilang Moran dari pasangan outlier (tanda)` = sign(sum(mnum[inv])))
}))))
kt(decomp, 1); save_csv(decomp, "26_dekomposisi_kontribusi_outlier")
```

```{r lisa-compute}
lisa_one <- function(x, lw, seed) {
  r <- localmoran_perm(x, lw, nsim = NSIM, iseed = seed, alternative = "two.sided", zero.policy = TRUE, no_repeat_in_row = TRUE)
  q <- as.character(attr(r, "quadr")$mean)
  q <- c("High-High" = "HH", "Low-Low" = "LL", "High-Low" = "HL", "Low-High" = "LH")[q]
  p <- r[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"]
  tibble(Ii = r[, "Ii"], z = r[, "Z.Ii"], p = p, p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "BH"), p_bonf = p.adjust(p, "bonferroni"),
         quad = unname(q), class_raw = ifelse(p < ALPHA, quad, "NS"), class_fdr = ifelse(p_fdr < ALPHA, quad, "NS"))
}
lisa <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(specs)), function(s) bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(VARS), function(v)
  lisa_one(col[[VARS[v]]], LW[[specs$id[s]]], SEED + 1000L * s + 10L * v + 5L) |>
    mutate(spec_id = specs$id[s], var = VARS[v], POLYID = col$POLYID))))) |>
  relocate(spec_id, var, POLYID)
save_csv(lisa, "19_lisa_semua_spesifikasi")
lisa_summ <- lisa |> group_by(spec_id, var) |>
  summarise(`Sig. (p mentah)` = sum(class_raw != "NS"), `Sig. (FDR)` = sum(class_fdr != "NS"),
            `Sig. (Bonferroni)` = sum(p_bonf < ALPHA),
            HH = sum(class_fdr == "HH"), LL = sum(class_fdr == "LL"), HL = sum(class_fdr == "HL"), LH = sum(class_fdr == "LH"),
            .groups = "drop")
ref_cls <- lisa |> filter(spec_id == REF) |> select(var, POLYID, ref_class = class_fdr, ref_raw = class_raw)
kappa <- function(a, b) { lv <- union(a, b); po <- mean(a == b); pe <- sum(sapply(lv, function(l) mean(a == l) * mean(b == l)))
  if (pe >= 1 - 1e-12) NA_real_ else (po - pe) / (1 - pe) }
jaccard <- function(a, b) { A <- a != "NS"; B <- b != "NS"; if (!any(A | B)) NA_real_ else sum(A & B) / sum(A | B) }
lisa_agree <- lisa |> left_join(ref_cls, by = c("var", "POLYID")) |> group_by(spec_id, var) |>
  summarise(`Sama dgn acuan, FDR (%)` = 100 * mean(class_fdr == ref_class),
            `Sama dgn acuan, p mentah (%)` = 100 * mean(class_raw == ref_raw),
            `Kappa vs acuan (p mentah)` = kappa(class_raw, ref_raw), `Jaccard sig. vs acuan (p mentah)` = jaccard(class_raw, ref_raw),
            `Kappa vs acuan (FDR)` = kappa(class_fdr, ref_class), .groups = "drop")
lisa_summ <- left_join(lisa_summ, lisa_agree, by = c("spec_id", "var")) |>
  left_join(select(specs, spec_id = id, label, order, family, style), by = "spec_id") |> arrange(var, order)
save_csv(lisa_summ, "20_lisa_ringkasan_per_spesifikasi")
kt(lisa_summ |> filter(spec_id == REF) |> select(var, `Sig. (p mentah)`:`Sig. (Bonferroni)`, HH:LH), 0)
```

```{r lisa-audit}
meanI <- lisa |> filter(grepl("_W$", spec_id)) |> group_by(spec_id, var) |> summarise(mI = mean(Ii), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(glob |> filter(index == "Moran's I") |> select(spec_id, var, stat), by = c("spec_id", "var"))
d_meanI <- max(abs(meanI$mI - meanI$stat))
own_lisa <- function(x, W, R, seed) {
  set.seed(seed); n <- length(x); z <- x - mean(x); m2 <- sum(z^2) / n
  sapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    nb <- which(W[i, ] != 0); w <- W[i, nb]; others <- z[-i]
    obs <- z[i] / m2 * sum(w * z[nb])
    sim <- z[i] / m2 * replicate(R, sum(w * sample(others, length(nb))))   # tanpa pengembalian
    min(1, 2 * min((sum(sim >= obs) + 1) / (R + 1), (sum(sim <= obs) + 1) / (R + 1)))
  })
}
lisa_chk <- bind_rows(lapply(c("CRIME", "PLUMB"), function(v) {
  ps <- own_lisa(col[[v]], Wq, NSIM, SEED + 6000L + match(v, VARS))
  r <- lisa |> filter(spec_id == REF, var == v) |> arrange(POLYID)
  se <- 2 * sqrt(pmax(r$p / 2, 1 / NSIM) * (1 - r$p / 2) / NSIM)
  tibble(var = v, POLYID = r$POLYID, p_spdep = r$p, p_sendiri = ps, rasio = abs(r$p - ps) / (sqrt(2) * se))
}))
lisa_audit <- tibble(Pemeriksaan = c("Maks |rata-rata Iᵢ − I global| (16 W row-standardized × 6 variabel)",
                                     "Permutasi bersyarat sendiri vs spdep: maks |Δp| / (√2 × SE Monte Carlo) (98 wilayah)",
                                     "Persentase wilayah dengan rasio < 2",
                                     "Klasifikasi signifikan p mentah sama (sendiri vs spdep)"),
                     Nilai = c(format(d_meanI, digits = 3), format(max(lisa_chk$rasio), digits = 3),
                               paste0(round(100 * mean(lisa_chk$rasio < 2), 1), "%"),
                               paste0(sum((lisa_chk$p_spdep < ALPHA) == (lisa_chk$p_sendiri < ALPHA)), " dari ", nrow(lisa_chk))))
kt(lisa_audit); save_csv(lisa_audit, "19b_audit_lisa"); save_csv(lisa_chk, "19c_audit_lisa_detail")
stopifnot(d_meanI < 1e-10)
```

```{r lisa-v1-vs-v2}
lisa_mode <- function(x, lw, seed, nr) { r <- localmoran_perm(x, lw, nsim = NSIM, iseed = seed, alternative = "two.sided", zero.policy = TRUE, no_repeat_in_row = nr)
  p <- r[, "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim"]; c(raw = sum(p < ALPHA), fdr = sum(p.adjust(p, "BH") < ALPHA)) }
cases <- bind_rows(tibble(spec = REF, var = VARS), tibble(spec = setdiff(specs$id, REF), var = "CRIME"))
v1v2 <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(cases)), function(i) {
  s <- match(cases$spec[i], specs$id); v <- match(cases$var[i], VARS); seed <- SEED + 1000L * s + 10L * v + 5L
  a <- lisa_mode(col[[VARS[v]]], LW[[cases$spec[i]]], seed, FALSE); b <- lisa_mode(col[[VARS[v]]], LW[[cases$spec[i]]], seed, TRUE)
  tibble(Spesifikasi = specs$label[s], Variabel = VARS[v], `Sig. p mentah, v1 (dgn pengembalian)` = a[["raw"]], `Sig. p mentah, v2` = b[["raw"]],
         `Sig. FDR, v1` = a[["fdr"]], `Sig. FDR, v2` = b[["fdr"]]) }))
kt(filter(v1v2, Spesifikasi == specs$label[specs$id == REF]))

cat(sprintf("CRIME, 32 W: total wilayah signifikan FDR v1 = %d, v2 = %d; W dengan ≥1 wilayah FDR: v1 = %d, v2 = %d\n",
            sum(crime_v$`Sig. FDR, v1`), sum(crime_v$`Sig. FDR, v2`), sum(crime_v$`Sig. FDR, v1` > 0), sum(crime_v$`Sig. FDR, v2` > 0)))
```

```{r global-local}
kt(gl_summ, 1); save_csv(gl, "24_konsistensi_global_lokal"); save_csv(gl_summ, "25_konsistensi_global_lokal_ringkasan")
```

```{r moran-scatter, fig.height = 6}
p_ms; save_png(p_ms, "20_moran_scatterplot_acuan", 11, 7)
```

```{r export}
rings <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(col)), function(i) {
  m <- st_coordinates(st_geometry(col)[[i]])
  grp <- interaction(as.data.frame(m[, grep("^L", colnames(m)), drop = FALSE]), drop = TRUE)
  unname(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(m)), grp), function(r) round(unname(m[r, 1:2]), 5)))
})
edges_all <- lapply(specs$id, function(id) { nb <- LW[[id]]$neighbours   # pasangan tak berarah unik (indeks 1..49)
  e <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(nb), function(i) cbind(pmin(i, nb[[i]]), pmax(i, nb[[i]]))))
  unique(e) })
names(edges_all) <- specs$id
results <- list(
  meta = list(title = "Ketika Definisi Tetangga Mengubah Realitas Spasial: Kritik terhadap Moran's I dan Geary's C", version = "2",
              data_source = data_source, n = nrow(col), nsim = NSIM, seed = SEED, alpha = ALPHA, ref = REF,
              generated = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
              r = R.version.string, spdep = as.character(packageVersion("spdep")), sf = as.character(packageVersion("sf")),
              distance_unit = "satuan peta (koordinat digitasi arbitrer; CRS tidak terdefinisi)",
              d1max = d1max, vars = VARS, var_desc = as.list(var_desc)),
  regions = list(POLYID = col$POLYID, rings = rings, centroid = round(unname(cc), 5)),
  values = st_drop_geometry(col)[, c("POLYID", VARS)],
  descriptives = desc, specs = select(specs, -key), global = glob,
  sensitivity_num = sens_num, sensitivity_inf = sens_inf, sensitivity_local = sens_loc, sensitivity_family = sens_fam,
  slopes = slopes, standardization = std_summ, standardization_mechanism = std_mech, agreement = agree, agreement_rate = agree_rate,
  jackknife = jk_summ, rank = rank_summ, comparison = cmp_tab, comparison_count = cmp_count,
  audit = audit, lisa_audit = lisa_audit, spec_search = ss, crime_fdr = crime_fdr, noise_dz = NOISE_DZ,
  lisa = select(lisa, spec_id, var, POLYID, Ii, z, p, p_fdr, quad, class_raw, class_fdr),
  lisa_summary = lisa_summ, local_support = loc_sup, global_local = gl, edges = edges_all)
saveRDS(c(results, list(sf = col)), file.path(OUT, "rds", "columbus_results.rds"))
saveRDS(LW, file.path(OUT, "rds", "weights_listw.rds"))
json_txt <- toJSON(results, dataframe = "columns", digits = I(10), auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
writeLines(json_txt, file.path(OUT, "json", "columbus_results.json"))

# Dashboard HTML: sisipkan JSON yang sama ke template (sumber tunggal)
tpl <- "dashboard_html/template.html"
if (file.exists(tpl)) {
  html <- paste(readLines(tpl, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")
  html <- sub("/*__DATA__*/null", gsub("</", "<\\/", json_txt, fixed = TRUE), html, fixed = TRUE)
  fonts <- list.files("assets/fonts", "^(inter|source-serif-4)-.*\\.woff2$", full.names = TRUE)
  ff <- vapply(fonts, function(f) {
    fam <- if (startsWith(basename(f), "source-serif-4")) "Source Serif 4" else "Inter"
    wt <- regmatches(f, regexpr("[0-9]{3}", f))
    encoded <- jsonlite::base64_enc(readBin(f, "raw", file.info(f)$size))
    sprintf("@font-face{font-family:'%s';font-weight:%s;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,%s) format('woff2')}",
            fam, wt, gsub("[\r\n]", "", encoded))
  }, "")
  html <- sub("/*__FONTS__*/", paste(ff, collapse = "\n"), html, fixed = TRUE)
  writeLines(html, "dashboard_html/index.html", useBytes = TRUE)
}
tibble(Berkas = c(list.files(file.path(OUT, "csv")), list.files(file.path(OUT, "png")),
                  list.files(file.path(OUT, "rds")), list.files(file.path(OUT, "json")))) |>
  mutate(Folder = sub(".*\\.", "", Berkas)) |> count(Folder, name = "Jumlah berkas") |> kt()
```
